The institutional investor held 47,998 shares of the restaurants company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $8.26M, up from 45,942 at the end of the previous reported quarter. First Midwest Bank Trust Division who had been investing in Mcdonalds Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $126.66B market cap company.
